description: Ministry of Labour - Industrial Dispute between Branch Administrative Association and Insurance Employees union Vs Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation Ltd.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the appointment of an arbitrator under the Industrial Disputes Act to settle a specific labor dispute. It involves legal procedures, references to specific legislation (Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon), and the exercise of statutory powers. While it mentions a Minister's name and title, it does not describe detailed portfolio responsibilities but rather demonstrates the execution of legal authority under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
